name: @avatark/world-persistence-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral, database-neutral contracts for durable Living World persistence (Sprint 9): WorldInstance/WorldDefinition identity, DurableWorldState, WorldCheckpoint, WorldSystemEventRecord, optimistic-concurrency and lease/lifecycle contracts, and repository interfaces. No implementations, no Postgres/Supabase-specific types, zero franchise content.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
